NOTE: TWO complete dumps in one region, which is routine rather than exotic: GAP-137's
own diagnosis recipe tells an operator to `kill -3` the engine, and doing so inside
the watchdog's 3s settle window appends a second dump to the same region. The first
dump here is healthy (8 running), the second is the wedge (8 blocked). Only the
second describes the engine now, so the answer is 8 seen / 8 blocked.

KILLS: summing across dumps instead of resetting on each `Full thread dump` line
(reports 16 seen / 8 blocked — "saturated", so a real wedge is never recovered), and
evaluating the FIRST dump in the region instead of the last (reports 8 / 0).
